# Extract build_model_settings() and build_usage_limits()

ADR 0055 decision 3, SECOND extraction. Sequenced after the except-spine extraction because both edit
run(); there is no logical dependency between them.

## Scope

- src/rebar/llm/runner.py ~384-463 -> two plain functions with EXPLICIT parameters:
      build_model_settings(cfg, req, caps, resolved, *, model_override) -> dict
      build_usage_limits(cfg, req, UsageLimits) -> tuple
  covering max_tokens, timeout, temperature (incl. the withdrawal matrix), max_iterations and the
  per-run request ceiling.
- tests/unit/

## Explicitly NOT a frozen carrier object

ADR 0055 rejects the `ResolvedCall` dataclass an earlier draft proposed. Two of its seven fields
(model_settings, provenance) are mutated after construction -- task cc33 writes
provider_provenance["ran_model"] AFTER the finally block -- so the freeze would be decorative exactly
where it matters, at a cost of ~30-40 lines of replace() ceremony to relocate ~113 lines of code. Use
explicit parameters; introduce a carrier only if a signature exceeds ~6 parameters.

## Honest accounting

This region is 50% comment: ~80 lines is ~36 lines of executable code. The comments TRAVEL WITH the
code -- they are the temperature-deprecation matrix and the per-request-vs-config precedence
rationale, and they are the reason the region is readable at all. Do not strip them to hit a number.
Per AGENTS.md, do not create a module under 100 LOC by splitting: group these into ONE themed module
rather than a file per function.

## Testing

Unit tier, no network -- pure given cfg/req/caps.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] a test asserts temperature is WITHDRAWN for a caps record with supports_temperature False and
      RETAINED when True -- the negative control is what stops a "withdraw always" implementation passing
- [ ] a test asserts a per-request output cap can only RAISE the configured floor, never lower it
- [ ] a test asserts a per-request step budget likewise only raises
- [ ] the extracted module is at or above the 100-LOC anti-fragmentation floor
- [ ] any monkeypatch target that moved is repointed IN THE SAME COMMIT and named in the message
